content: expo-file-system SDK 57: new API is File/Directory/Paths classes (in Expo Go); legacy function API (getInfoAsync/writeAsStringAsync/StorageAccessFramework) moved to 'expo-file-system/legacy' import — old methods imported from the main module throw at runtime. StorageAccessFramework namespace (Android only) remains in legacy: requestDirectoryPermissionsAsync() (user picks Downloads), createFileAsync(uri, name, mime), writeAsStringAsync(fileUri, content, {encoding:'base64'}) — this is the documented way to write to public Downloads in Expo Go. New File class has contentUri (Android) for sharing. Verified against official SDK 57 docs pages (filesystem + filesystem-legacy).
